description: Returns a thread's post and comments as numbered Markdown ([c12] reply to [c3] (score 41, 3d ago)). Long threads come in pages: call again with the offset given at the end. Cite comments by their [cN] number.

min_score.description: Only comments with at least this score (hidden scores are left out)

offset.description: Skip this many comments (for the next page)

thread.description: Thread id from list_threads, or words from its title

name: read_thread
title: Read a thread
